adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb` under `context ".add_members"`, the test `"cannot add members to automatic groups"` calls `xhr :put, :add_members, group_id: 1, usernames: "l77t"` and only asserts `response.status.should == 422`. This relies on a magic `group_id: 1` being an automatic group (no setup in this spec block) and does not verify that no membership change occurred (e.g., user count unchanged). As written, it only checks the status code, so it’s a brittle/weak test for the new automatic-group guard in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`.
